testResults.name: ui-contract-alignment
testResults.command: svelte-check on src/ui/src/lib/api.ts (0 errors); vitest api tests 16/18 (2 failures are the UX agent's ScreenerPanel rebuild surface, tracked on T230)
testResults.result: api.ts screener functions aligned to the real contract: listScreeners, saveScreener, runScreener, getScreenerResult with ScreenerFilterSpec params, ScreenerRunInput including as_of, and ScreenerRunResult with rank/metric hits; fixture mode translates legacy filters to the native vocabulary

limitations: ProgramExecutor seam left for T229: run_program(program, ctx, executor=InProcessProgramExecutor) is the single documented replacement point; the T229 sandbox plugs in there

Classification schema has no SIC columns yet (D006 selection: Nasdaq file lacks SIC); sic_code and sic_industry facts populate when the reference ingest adds them - filter logic is port-tested and ready
OhlcvPort and CikIndex are thin protocols; production adapters for the local lake root and the symbol-to-CIK index are the remaining production wiring
ScreenerStore is in-memory; a durable persistence adapter is deferred

A concurrently-landed src/thesis/http/screeners.py serves the legacy UI vocabulary at /screeners while the engine-native router lives at /screening; both are mounted and the coordinator owns reconciling which surface api.ts targets
